name: Benjamin Sebastian Sawyer III
education: Grant High School, Portland, class of 1949.
career: Owned and ran Sawyer Communications in Portland and later in Walnut Creek and Martinez, California.
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 155822857 (Dorothy Helen Groves Sawyer)
Obituary of Benjamin S. Sawyer III, Weaver Mortuary, Beaumont, California, Oct 2014 (Dignity Memorial)
notes: Born 10 Nov 1931 in Seattle; died 9 Oct 2014, of Banning, California. Survived by his wife Carolyn, his children Brent, Lyn and Benjamin, and fifteen grandchildren.
